nodes.name: .gitattributes
nodes.summary: Enforces LF line endings for all files (container compatibility) and marks test fixtures as binary to preserve byte-exact recorded HTTP responses for archive digest checks.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer that marks the core/ directory as a Python package, the root namespace for financial computations and database access.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package initializer for core/compute/ documenting the strict no-I/O contract: every function takes values and returns values with no database, network, or LLM calls.
nodes.languageNotes: Docstring-only package init enforcing the pure-function architectural boundary for financial computations.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer for core/db/, the namespace for point-in-time database access functions.

nodes.name: temporal-model.md
nodes.summary: Defines the three-time model (event_time, as_of, recorded_at), append-only store semantics, and replay isolation rules that every store in the system must follow; also covers hypothesis storage (R3) and enforcement via test_architecture.py.
nodes.languageNotes: 8 sections covering temporal semantics, timeline shapes, reprising under rule changes, and live vs replay isolation.

nodes.name: script.py.mako
nodes.summary: Alembic migration script template used to generate new migration files; emits the standard revision metadata and empty upgrade/downgrade stubs with the project required imports.

nodes.name: 0001_financial_facts.py
nodes.summary: Initial Alembic migration that enables pgvector, creates the append-only forbid_mutation trigger function, and creates the financial_facts table with XBRL line items, computed ratios, and full provenance columns (as_of, content_hash, source_url, extracted_by, model_version).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses sa.Numeric (Decimal-safe) for all monetary values; row and statement triggers enforce the append-only R2 rule.

nodes.name: upgrade
nodes.summary: Creates the pgvector extension, the forbid_mutation PL/pgSQL trigger (used by all append-only stores), and the financial_facts table with 14 columns, check constraints, and a covering index.

nodes.name: 0002_raw_source_file.py
nodes.summary: Alembic migration creating the raw_source_file table, which stores blob storage references (content_hash-keyed) for every fetched source file before parsing, enabling parser re-runs without re-downloading.

nodes.name: upgrade
nodes.summary: Creates the raw_source_file table with provenance columns, a content_hash uniqueness constraint, and the append-only triggers inherited from migration 0001.

nodes.name: 0003_entity_and_index_snapshots.py
nodes.summary: Alembic migration creating the entity (ISIN-keyed company master), index_snapshot, index_snapshot_constituent, and index_snapshot_mapping tables with full provenance and append-only enforcement, seeding known index names.
nodes.languageNotes: Creates a custom Enum type for corporate_action_type; manages enum lifecycle explicitly with create/drop for Postgres compatibility.

nodes.name: upgrade
nodes.summary: Creates four tables (entity, index_snapshot, index_snapshot_constituent, index_snapshot_mapping), seeds initial index names (Nifty 50, Nifty Next 50, etc.), and attaches append-only triggers to each.

nodes.name: 0004_index_snapshot_rule_versioned.py
nodes.summary: Alembic migration that alters the unique constraint on index_snapshot_constituent to include rule_version, enabling multiple rule-versioned computations of membership intervals from the same snapshot data.

nodes.name: 0005_nse_bhavcopy.py
nodes.summary: Alembic migration creating the nse_bhavcopy_row (daily OHLCV records from NSE bhavcopy archives) and nse_bhavcopy_quarantine tables, with a QUARANTINE_REASON enum and full provenance columns.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses sa.Numeric for all price/volume fields; quarantine table enables manual review of rejected rows without losing data.

nodes.name: upgrade
nodes.summary: Creates QUARANTINE_REASON enum, the nse_bhavcopy_row table (OHLCV with ISIN key), and nse_bhavcopy_quarantine table, seeding ingest source class rows and attaching append-only triggers.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer making tests/ a Python package, enabling pytest discovery and relative imports within test modules.

nodes.name: SOURCES.md
nodes.summary: Documents the origin, fetch date, and content summary of the recorded NSE bhavcopy fixture file used in adapter tests, confirming byte-exact preservation and spot-checking against a known ISIN.

nodes.name: test_architecture.py
nodes.summary: AST-based architecture enforcement test suite that checks the live codebase for violations of CLAUDE.md rules: no float for money, LLM gateway imports only from extract/narrate, store reads only through core/db/pit.py, MCP imports only in ingest/gateway, and provenance columns on all ORM table models.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Python ast module to parse and walk the source tree of every project file without executing it; each rule is a standalone function returning violation strings.

nodes.name: SourceFile
nodes.summary: Dataclass wrapping a project Python file with its relative path and parsed AST, providing helpers for module name derivation and package-prefix membership checks used by all rule functions.

nodes.name: repo_files
nodes.summary: Walks the project tree, parses every Python file with ast.parse, and returns a cached tuple of SourceFile objects, skipping virtual envs, __pycache__, and non-.py files.

nodes.name: check_gateway_imports
nodes.summary: Enforces that the LLM gateway package (gateway/) is only imported by extract/ and narrate/ modules; returns violation strings for any other importer.

nodes.name: check_provider_sdk_imports
nodes.summary: Enforces that LLM provider SDKs (anthropic, openai, google.genai, etc.) are only imported inside gateway/; returns violations for any import outside that boundary.

nodes.name: check_no_float_money
nodes.summary: Scans all non-test Python files for type annotations, function calls, and argument types that mention float in a money context, returning violations to enforce the Decimal-only rule for financial values (R1).

nodes.name: check_provenance_columns
nodes.summary: Inspects SQLAlchemy ORM table model classes to verify each has the five required provenance columns (as_of, content_hash, source_url, extracted_by, model_version), returning violation strings for missing columns.

nodes.name: check_compute_is_pure
nodes.summary: Verifies that core/compute/ modules only import from stdlib, typing, and decimal packages and do not import database, network, or LLM modules, enforcing the no-I/O contract.

nodes.name: check_reads_go_through_pit
nodes.summary: Ensures that SQLAlchemy Session and Connection objects are only accessed through core/db/pit.py by flagging any code outside that module that directly calls session.execute or uses select/update ORM constructs.

nodes.name: check_mcp_imports
nodes.summary: Enforces that MCP client packages (mcp, fastmcp) are only imported by ingest/ adapters and gateway/, preventing model-free MCP calls from slipping into core or other layers.

nodes.name: check_ingest_modules_declare
nodes.summary: Verifies that each ingest/ adapter module declares its SOURCE_CLASS and TARGET_STORE constants, ensuring the ingest registry is complete and consistent.

nodes.name: test_scan_is_not_vacuous
nodes.summary: Sanity-checks that repo_files() found a meaningful set of source files (at least 10 Python files including core/__init__.py) so that a misconfigured scan does not pass all rules vacuously.
